label: Three comparisons of actuality and capacity in Aristotle Θ.8
summary: Θ.8 separates the reference to exercise in the account of a capacity, priority in substance by form or end, and qualified temporal priority. In time, the seed precedes the mature individual, but a numerically different actual individual of the same kind precedes the seed; in the generation under discussion, what is potential always comes to actuality through something already actual. An individual’s own capacity can precede its exercise.
blocker: Choose and justify the route’s binary RoutePrior on beings and show how every InPotency instance has an actual witness in the same respect, including a potency that is never realized. Reference to an activity in the account of a capacity gives a relation with different arguments from RoutePrior.
